assessments.reasoning: The general data-reference clause gives a word LOCATION formal the same storage as the actual. The immediately following word-specific clause fixes when the index expressions are evaluated. VALUE setup, whole ARRAY formals, and TABLE formals have distinct entries and cannot broaden this statement.

limitations: Scope is the definition with the February 1973 revised preface. The rule excludes VALUE parameters, part-word actuals, and the distinct rules for ARRAY and TABLE formals.
